note: Manual test cases drafted by Devin for stories that do not yet have Xray issues (Xray is not installed on the Jira site). Keys follow <STORY>-TC<n>; when the Test issues are created in Xray, replace the key here and in the spec's xray annotation.

tests.summary: Debit transaction is shown in red with a negative amount
tests.precondition: Persona demo.user exists and its first account has at least one debit transaction in the seed
steps: On the accounts overview, open the first account
Look at the Amount column of every row whose amount starts with a minus sign
tests.expected: Each debit amount is formatted as a negative GBP value (e.g. -£78.42) and rendered in the brand red (#ec0000)

tests.summary: Statement header shows the same balance as the accounts overview
tests.precondition: Persona demo.user exists and holds two accounts
steps: Note the balance shown on the first account card
Read the Balance shown in the statement header
Select Back to accounts and repeat for the second account
tests.expected: For every account the statement header balance is identical to the balance shown on the accounts overview card, and both match the seeded balance

tests.summary: Credit transaction is shown without a minus sign and not in red
tests.precondition: Persona demo.user exists and its first account has at least one credit transaction (Salary) in the seed
steps: Look at the Amount column of every row whose amount does not start with a minus sign
tests.expected: Each credit amount is formatted as a positive GBP value (e.g. £2,020.00) and is not rendered in the debit red
